title: Aptera Completes Its First Solar Electric Vehicle for Customer Delivery
summary: Aptera Completes Its First Solar Electric Vehicle for Customer Delivery Carlsbad, CA — November 19, 2026 — Aptera Motors Corp. (Nasdaq: SEV), a solar mobility

**Carlsbad, CA — November 19, 2026 —** Aptera Motors Corp. (Nasdaq: SEV), a solar mobility company advancing ultra-efficient transportation, today announced it has completed its first vehicle for sale to a customer, a milestone years in the making for Aptera’s team, investors and reservation holders. The customer is excited to take delivery of Aptera’s first production solar electric vehicle. Aptera intends to export the vehicle to the customer outside of the United States.


The vehicle was built for Accelerator #1, Martin Hartono, and finished in Noir, a matte black exterior the customer selected. Accelerators are the early investors who helped make Aptera a reality, with delivery positions ordered by the amount each invested in the company.


Aptera’s three-wheeled solar electric vehicle charges from solar panels integrated into its body, and it plugs in like any other electric vehicle. Its built-in solar panels are designed to add up to approximately 40 miles of driving a day from sunlight alone, under favorable conditions.


“This is the moment our team has worked toward for years,” said Chris Anthony, Co-CEO of Aptera. “To Accelerator #1, and to every reservation holder and shareholder who believed in this vehicle: thank you. We’re working to complete more vehicles for early customers as soon as possible.”


“We set out to build a vehicle that harnesses the sun. Now the first one built for a customer is complete,” said Steve Fambro, Co-CEO of Aptera. “That moment belongs to everyone on our team and to the community that helped bring it here.”


“What excites me about Aptera is how innovation can redefine the way we use energy in everyday mobility. By combining solar technology, battery power and an ultra-efficient vehicle design, Aptera offers a compelling solution for people who want to minimize their energy consumption without compromising the ability to travel long distances. As an early believer in Aptera, I am proud to be part of this milestone and to see this vision become a reality,” said Martin Hartono, CEO of GDP Venture.


**About Aptera Motors Corp.**
Aptera Motors Corp. (Nasdaq: SEV) is a solar mobility company driven by a mission to advance the future of efficient transportation. Its flagship vehicle is conceived to be a paradigm-shifting solar electric vehicle that leverages breakthroughs in aerodynamics, material science and solar technology to pursue new levels of efficiency. As a public benefit corporation, Aptera is committed to building a sustainable business that positively impacts its stakeholders and the environment. Aptera is headquartered in Carlsbad, California. For more information, please visit www.aptera.us.
